cards.example_en: She received an award for the best science project.
cards.example_zh: 她因为科学项目做得最好而获得了一个奖。

cards.example_en: She became aware of the smoke and called for a teacher.
cards.example_zh: 她察觉到烟味，立刻叫来了老师。

cards.example_en: Please put your phone away during class.
cards.example_zh: 上课时请把手机收起来。

cards.example_en: An awful smell came from the unlocked fridge this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，没关严的冰箱里冒出一股可怕的气味。

cards.example_en: The baby slept through the noisy ride home.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝在嘈杂的回家路上一直睡着。

cards.example_en: Please come back before dinner tonight.
cards.example_zh: 请今晚晚饭前回来。

cards.example_en: Tell me about your family background in a few sentences.
cards.example_zh: 用几句话介绍一下你的家庭背景。

cards.example_en: The bad apple at the bottom spoiled the rest of the fruit.
cards.example_zh: 底部的坏苹果把其余的水果也弄坏了。

cards.example_en: We play badminton in the gym when it rains.
cards.example_zh: 下雨的时候，我们就在体育馆里打羽毛球。

cards.example_en: My bag was heavy with books for the art class.
cards.example_zh: 我的书包里装满了美术课要用的书，沉得很。

cards.example_en: She tries to balance study and rest.
cards.example_zh: 她尽量平衡学习和休息。

cards.example_en: The ball rolled under the sofa during the game.
cards.example_zh: 玩游戏的时候，球滚到了沙发底下。

cards.example_en: A red balloon escaped and floated over the playground.
cards.example_zh: 一只红气球飞走了，飘到了操场的上空。

cards.example_en: The panda was eating fresh bamboo.
cards.example_zh: 熊猫在吃新鲜的竹子。

cards.example_en: I packed a banana for the long walk to school.
cards.example_zh: 我为走去学校的那一段长路带了一根香蕉。

cards.example_en: The school band practised drums in the music room.
cards.example_zh: 学校乐队在音乐教室里练习敲鼓。

cards.example_en: Mom stopped at the bank before picking me up.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈来接我之前，先去了银行一趟。

cards.example_en: We played baseball on the field after school.
cards.example_zh: 放学后我们在球场上打了棒球。

cards.example_en: Cooks learn basic knife skills before they cut vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 厨师在切菜之前先学基本的用刀技巧。

cards.example_en: She carried a basket of eggs from the market.
cards.example_zh: 她从市场提回一篮子鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: Tom practices basketball with his brother every evening.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆每天晚上和哥哥一起练习篮球。

cards.example_en: He swung the bat and hit the ball hard.
cards.example_zh: 他挥动球棒，狠狠击中了球。

cards.example_en: I take a hot bath after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练后我会洗个热水澡。

cards.example_en: The bathroom is upstairs next to my bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 浴室在楼上，紧挨着我的卧室。

cards.example_en: I want to be a teacher someday.
cards.example_zh: 我将来想当老师。

cards.example_en: We spent the whole day on the beach.
cards.example_zh: 我们在海滩上度过了一整天。

cards.example_en: There is a bean in my soup today.
cards.example_zh: 今天我的汤里有一颗豆子。

cards.example_en: I cannot bear the noise from the street at night.
cards.example_zh: 夜里我无法忍受街上的噪声。

cards.example_en: Our team can beat the visitors if we pass better.
cards.example_zh: 如果我们传球更好，就能打败客队。

cards.example_en: The beautiful bridge looks golden when the sun sets.
cards.example_zh: 日落时，那座美丽的桥看上去金灿灿的。

cards.example_en: She stayed home because she felt ill.
cards.example_zh: 她待在家里，因为她感觉不舒服。

cards.example_en: Leaves become red and gold on the hills in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，山上的叶子会变成红色和金色。

cards.example_en: I made my bed before leaving for school.
cards.example_zh: 去上学之前，我把床铺好了。

cards.example_en: My bedroom faces the school playground.
cards.example_zh: 我的卧室正对学校操场。

cards.example_en: A bee landed on the flower near our window.
cards.example_zh: 一只蜜蜂落在我们窗户附近的花上。

cards.example_en: We had beef and rice for Sunday dinner.
cards.example_zh: 星期天晚饭我们吃了牛肉和米饭。

cards.example_en: Wash your hands before you eat.
cards.example_zh: 吃饭前要洗手。

cards.example_en: Lessons begin when the bell rings in the main hall.
cards.example_zh: 主楼大厅的铃一响，课就开始了。

cards.example_en: Please behave well in the museum.
cards.example_zh: 请在博物馆表现好一点。

cards.example_en: The cat is hiding behind the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 猫躲在沙发后面。

cards.example_en: I can't believe it's already Friday.
cards.example_zh: 真不敢相信它已经到了。

cards.example_en: The school bell rang and we lined up.
cards.example_zh: 学校的铃响了，我们站好了队。

cards.example_en: These gloves belong to the girl who sits beside me.
cards.example_zh: 这副手套属于坐在我旁边的那个女孩。

cards.example_en: Write your name below the title.
cards.example_zh: 把名字写在标题下面。

cards.example_en: He tightened his belt before the long hike.
cards.example_zh: 长途步行之前，他把腰带系紧了。

cards.example_en: Exercise is a great benefit to your health.
cards.example_zh: 锻炼对健康大有益处。

cards.example_en: Please sit beside me at the front desk.
cards.example_zh: 请坐在前台我的旁边。

cards.example_en: She saved her best painting for the campus art show.
cards.example_zh: 她把最好的画留到校园画展上展出。

cards.example_en: This pencil is better for sketching than the cheap one.
cards.example_zh: 这支铅笔比那支便宜的更适合素描。

cards.example_en: The park is between the school and the shop.
cards.example_zh: 公园在学校和商店之间。

word.example_en: Are you aware of the Friday deadline?
word.example_zh: 你意识到星期五的截止日期了吗？

word.example_en: We give away old clothes every spring.
word.example_zh: 每年春天我们捐赠旧衣服。

word.example_en: In the novel, the old sailor will pass away at dawn.
word.example_zh: 小说里，老水手将在黎明去世。

word.example_en: The school will do away with paper tickets.
Keep away from the deep water.
Some members may break away from the old club.
word.example_zh: 有些成员可能会脱离原来的社团。

word.example_en: The delay is due to the storm.
word.example_zh: 延误是由暴风雨造成的。

word.example_en: She will be able to swim after a few lessons.
word.example_zh: 上几节课后，她将能够游泳。

word.example_en: Lin is fit for the role of captain.
Grandma is fond of morning walks.
The park is full of families on Sunday.
word.example_zh: 星期天公园里充满了家人。

word.example_en: We stayed in because of the storm.
word.example_zh: 因为暴风雨，我们待在室内。

word.example_en: He is behind in physics this month.
word.example_zh: 他这个月在物理方面落后了。
我相信持之以恒的练习。

word.example_en: Does this red cap belong to Lucy?
word.example_zh: 这顶红帽子属于露西吗？

word.example_en: They do their best on the oral test.
word.example_zh: 他们在口试上尽自己最大努力。

word.example_en: A note fell from between the pages.
word.example_zh: 一张纸条从书页之间掉出来。
